maintenance.workflow: READ -> PREVIEW -> EXPLICIT_APPROVAL -> APPLY -> DEPLOYMENT_VERIFY -> READ_BACK

inlineApprovalLanguage.rule: When 山下祐樹 gives an exact-scope non-destructive change request and in the same message explicitly waives preview presentation/extra confirmation (for example 承認いらない, 確認不要, プレビュー表示不要) AND uses an apply verb (for example 反映して, 記録して, 更新して, 実装して), treat that message as inline explicit approval for the matching internal Preview. Execute Preview internally, confirm the locked Preview exactly matches the requested scope, then Apply without asking an additional approval question. Internal Preview, approvalHash, nonce, race protection, and post-Apply Verify remain mandatory. This is not standing pre-approval for unspecified future changes. Destructive operations, ARCHIVE/DELETE, rollback, backup, or scope changes still require the applicable post-Preview approval.

interactionPresentation.rule: Approval hashes, preview expiry/deadline metadata, and changeId remain enforced or retained internally when required for safety, audit, rollback, or diagnostics, but are not displayed to the user unless explicitly requested. changeId is not a user-facing completion requirement.

idReusePolicy.rule: 旧移行データ由来のRESERVED_LEGACYは新しい正式IDとして再利用できる。現在の正式データをARCHIVEしたIDおよび削除後予約IDは再利用しない。3桁連番を詰める場合は未使用またはRESERVED_LEGACYの最小番号を優先する。

notes: This runtime policy may refine maintenance behavior but may not weaken MyGPT base safety rules.
GPT public Action contract is limited to 30 operations.
WORKBOOK_STATUS must not be promoted to PRODUCTION_READY until all live acceptance tests pass.

deployment.worker: GitHub Actions -> cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3 -> Wrangler v4 -> Cloudflare Worker
deployment.appsScript: GitHub Actions -> deploy_apps_script.py -> Apps Script API getContent/updateContent -> version -> deployment update
